integrity.novelty_risk: An unindexed or implicit earlier singular-edge optimization treatment may overlap.

scientific_limitations: One-dimensional drift-free diffusion with an absorbing endpoint, complete independent Poisson resets, exact bounded power-law spatial reset density.
No finite-gap uniqueness theorem for the optimal rate, no general regularly-varying edge-density endpoint classification, and no nonlinear drift extension.
The general first-passage and last-reset weighting formulas are acknowledged as prior work; related implicit formulas may permit equivalent unreported calculations.
title: A sharp edge-density threshold for optimal spatial resetting
